name: Oshawa–Finch Express
description: Highway 401 bus family linking Durham GO stations with North York. Multiple express and short branches were later consolidated as 96B; seasonal 96Z added the Toronto Zoo.

timeline.event: Routes 95 and 96 began as complementary Oshawa–Finch express services.
The original timetable documents 96 and branches A–D, with 96B serving Scarborough Centre between the Durham stations and Finch.
The original timetable contains the 96, 96A, 96B, 96C, 96D and 96E family.
Service was consolidated on 96B; branches 96, 96A, 96C, 96D and 96E were withdrawn.
Seasonal 96Z Toronto Zoo trips began alongside 96B.

gaps: An archive PDF named 2009-02-19-table-96 actually contains route 93. It has deliberately not been used as evidence for route 96.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
